titel: Click Cuts, galerijbeeld 'Draw your own cut' op Superhive (echt Blender-paneel, Draw cut uit 1.1, issue 277)
rol: You make or download 3D models and print them at home, but many models are bigger than your printer bed. You are browsing the Superhive (Blender Market) store for a Blender add-on that cuts a model into parts that fit your printer and go back together. You worry that an automatic tool will slice right through a character's face, so you want to see that you can choose where it cuts yourself. You are now looking at the gallery images that show each add-on inside Blender.

ons.naam: Draw cut onder de kin van het paard, met paneel en drie stappen
